SESSION_ID.description: Your session ID prefixed with 'trashcore~'. Leave blank to pair via console.

PREFIX.description: Bot command prefix. Example: . or ! or #

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code, no + or spaces. Example: 254758301051

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Your Heroku API key (found in Account Settings). Used for auto-restart.

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Your Heroku app name (used for auto-restart).
